title: Surrogate pipeline — use cases
description: Five runs of `pp.SurrogatePipeline`: a parametric surrogate over a reference campaign, a physics-only PINN scored against a closed form and exported to ONNX, a PDE written as text trained and validated by the PINN validation suite, the same pipeline driven from YAML with `run_until` / `resume` / the command line, and a tour that adds adaptive learning, `pinneapple check` as gate evidence and a served model. Every run prints the seven stages and the ten VeriPhysics gates, and the numbers below were measured by those runs (`_out/<name>/report.json`).

params.parameter space of 01: nu in [0.005, 0.06], 18 cases by Latin hypercube
params.training budget of 02: 1200 Adam epochs, 2048 collocation points, hidden 48 x 4
params.tour of 05: six runs: nrmse/adaptive targets, 1200-epoch PINN, 2000+400 symbolic steps

metrics.name: held-out nrmse, Gaussian process (01)
metrics.how: surrogate study on 3 cases held out of the 18, normalised RMSE over the 7 probe outputs

metrics.name: held-out nrmse, MLP (01)
metrics.how: same splits and budget as the Gaussian process, one seed

metrics.name: relative L2 of the PINN against Cole-Hopf (02)
metrics.how: pp.compare at 256 random points of the domain, reference method analytic

metrics.name: boundary/initial misfit of the PINN (02)
metrics.how: max |prediction - condition| over 1536 freshly sampled condition points, relative to the field scale

metrics.name: ONNX vs in-memory prediction (02)
metrics.how: max |onnx - pytorch| / max |pytorch| on 5 points of the domain

metrics.name: grid-refinement change of the reference solution (01)
metrics.how: the preset's FDM solution at nx = 256 and nx = 512, max difference relative to its own RMS

metrics.name: relative PDE residual of the symbolic PINN (03)
metrics.how: validate_pinn at 2048 fresh points, RMS of the residual relative to the scale of the terms

metrics.name: boundary misfit of the symbolic PINN (03)

metrics.name: initial misfit of the symbolic PINN (03)
metrics.how: validate_pinn: max |u - sin(pi x) sin(pi y)| at t = 0 relative to the solution scale

metrics.name: relative PDE residual of the same run at 300 epochs (03)
metrics.how: same validation at 300 Adam steps with no L-BFGS polish: the residual and both conditions fail

metrics.name: adaptive infill: nrmse after one round (05)
metrics.how: gp surrogate on 12 LHS cases, 3 cases added where the outputs vary most, re-studied: held-out nrmse 0.001597 -> 0.000418

metrics.name: exact-solution error of the symbolic PINN (05)
metrics.how: validate_pinn's pinn.exact check against sin(pi x) sin(pi y) exp(-2 pi^2 alpha t), 2048 fresh points

metrics.name: outcomes of `pinneapple check` over the run (05)
metrics.how: PC001/PC002 load and query, PC601 all 32 queries inside the training range, PC403 finite outputs; 0 failing

metrics.name: trust decision of the served model (05)
metrics.how: pipeline.deploy() on the parametric run: a query inside the validated domain returns ACCEPT, one outside is refused
